entities.summary: Gabriel Barbou des Courières, was a French general whose career spanned the Ancien Régime, the French Revolutionary Wars, and the Napoleonic Wars. Born into a military family, he entered the army in 1779 and rose steadily through the ranks, gaining early experience in the West Indies before returning to Europe during the War of the First Coalition. He distinguished himself in several major campaigns on the northern and Rhine fronts, earning rapid promotion to general officer through his conduct at battles and sieges including Fleurus, Aldenhoven, Würzburg, and Neuwied.
